thread:
maria.dev: Customer ACME (tenant acme-inc) reporting surge of 504s from hosted API in eu-west-1 since 03:20 UTC. Ticket #54321. They see timeouts on streaming calls mostly; non-streaming endpoints look OK.
opsbot: Alert: 504 spike 03:19-03:30 eu-west-1 edge-gateway, 5xx rate 3.8% -> 12.4%. Top upstreams: auth-service, midproxy.
sam_support: I repro'd a 504 quickly with a single curl against /v1/generate, attaching repro steps.
sam_support: ```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","input":"hi"}'
  https://api.eu.example.com/v1/generate
```
jordan_sre: Can you paste the x-edge-trace-id from the 504 response headers? Need that to find the full trace in observability.
maria.dev: From customer logs: x-edge-trace-id=et-202603200324-abc123. Also saw upstream connect_timeout in envoy: "upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before response headers" in edge logs.
maria.dev: log excerpt:
```text
[envoy] 03:24:12.345 | upstream reset: connection failure | upstream: auth-service:6379 | connect_timeout
[edge] 03:24:12.346 | response 504 to tenant=acme-inc reqid=et-202603200324-abc123
```
lee_ops: FYI auth-service had a rolling restart for config rollout at ~03:18 UTC in eu-west-1. During restart Redis-backed auth-cache showed elevated p99 reads ~800ms. Could explain increased auth validation latency.
jordan_sre: Hypothesis: edge synchronously calls auth service during connection setup for streaming requests. If auth backend hiccups, connections stack and envoy hits upstream connect timeout -> 504s. Also conn-pool exhaustion possible. Need conn pool / open connections dashboard.
sam_support: Quick mitigation options: enable local auth-cache fallback (short TTL), increase envoy upstream connect_timeout for auth cluster to 3s, and throttle inbound per-tenant fanout while we stabilize.
maria.dev: I pushed a temporary tenant-level fanout throttle for acme-inc and rolled back the auth deployment at 03:37. Errors dropped back to baseline by ~03:45. I updated the customer ticket with timeline and mitigation.
deploybot: Deploy rollback completed: deployment/auth-service eu-west-1 -> rolled back to revision v11 at 03:37:12.
lee_ops: Action items: 1) Add pre-warm probes / readiness for auth pods during rollout, 2) tune auth cluster connect_timeout & keepalive values in envoy template, 3) implement local TTL cache for token validation (~30s) to reduce auth fanout. I'll file infra ticket INFRA-9812.
sam_support: Noted, updated ACME ticket and sent customer follow-up with repro and workaround.
jordan_sre: I'll attach trace et-202603200324-abc123 and spike graphs to the postmortem. Creating incident record and assigning owners. Closing this thread after IR created.
